name: Bean (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Bean [Pulses] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
curation_sources: USDA FDC 173747 (Beans, kidney, all types, mature seeds, raw; NDB 16033) - full macro/mineral/vitamin/amino-acid/fatty-acid panel
Foods 2025 doi:10.3390/foods15020391 (soluble carbohydrates / RFOs in Phaseolus)
Plants 2021 doi:10.3390/plants10071465 (raffinose-family oligosaccharide pathway in P. vulgaris)

PMC10820859 (NMR metabolomics of P. vulgaris seed; citric/malic/lactic acids, sucrose, stachyose)
Springer doi:10.1007/BF01091932 & Frontiers 2023 doi:10.3389/fsufs.2023.1282427 (phytic acid ~11.5 mg/g)
ScienceDirect S0889157510000852 (P. vulgaris seed mineral diversity incl. Mo)
provenance.curation_notes: Generic FooDB 'Bean' curated as raw mature common/kidney bean (P. vulgaris) seed. DOMINANT carbon/energy source is starch (~33 g/100g); the growth-relevant free-carbohydrate pool is sucrose plus the fermentable raffinose-family oligosaccharides (stachyose > raffinose > verbascose), which USDA total sugars misses. High protein (24 g) gives a rich amino-acid pool (Glu/Asp/Lys-rich). Key organic acids are phytic (~1.15 g), oxalic (~0.1 g), plus malic and citric (present, whole-seed amounts not stan
curation_added: stachyose, raffinose, verbascose (raffinose-family oligosaccharides - major fermentable sugars absent from USDA total-sugars)
phytic acid (major seed organic acid / P store)
malic acid, citric acid, lactic acid (dominant free organic acids, present-but-unquantified)
quantified vitamins (B1/B2/B3/B5/B6, folate, K, E, C, choline)
linoleic acid, total saturated fatty acids, starch, fiber, total protein amounts

curation_removed.name: Cholesterol
curation_removed.reason: Animal sterol; not synthesized by plants and absent from bean seed. FooDB predicted/implausible for a plant matrix.

curation_removed.name: Cyanocobalamin
curation_removed.reason: Vitamin B12 is made only by prokaryotes; plants (beans) contain none. USDA lists B12 = 0. FooDB noise.

curation_removed.name: Retinol
curation_removed.reason: Preformed (animal) vitamin A; beans contain none (USDA vitamin A RAE = 0). Provitamin carotenoids only, at trace level.

curation_removed.name: Lycopene
curation_removed.reason: Tomato/watermelon carotenoid; not a constituent of common bean seed. FooDB noise/misassignment.

curation_removed.name: Beta-Carotene
curation_removed.reason: Negligible/zero in mature dry bean seed (USDA beta-carotene = 0); drop as non-quantifiable trace rather than list a real amount.

curation_removed.name: Co2+
curation_removed.reason: Cobalt occurs only at ultratrace level and is nutritionally relevant only bound in B12, which beans lack; non-nutritive trace ion.

curation_removed.name: Nickel
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace, non-nutritive contaminant element, not a defining growth nutrient of bean.

curation_removed.name: Fluoride
curation_removed.reason: Ultratrace, non-nutritive element for a growth medium; not a bean-defining nutrient.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+)
curation_removed.reason: Redundant duplicate of iron (already reported once as total iron, 8.2 mg/100g); FooDB lists the same element in multiple redox/compartment forms.

curation_removed.name: Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Redundant compartment-tagged duplicate of iron; not a separate nutrient.

basis: per 100 g raw mature dry seed; Phaseolus vulgaris (common/kidney bean) used as the representative of the generic FooDB 'Bean' pulse record

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all divides components by (components + unresolved ingredients). It counts pipeline-derived components as covered, so it is not a measure of how much of the source's own ingredient list was captured. pct_covered_source divides source-stated components by (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components), which is that measure. Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
